# GNK ASG Web & Mobile 10x Upgrade Roadmap

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Objective

Prepare a complete improvement package so the portal becomes easier to understand, faster on mobile, stronger for search visibility, clearer for third-party users and ready for autonomous publishing, video, mail and calendar agent workflows.

## Core principle

The portal should feel like a professional corporate operating system, not a collection of separate modules. Every visitor should understand what GNK ASG is, what GNK DINAMO Ltd. represents, who Nermin Sefic is in the public corporate framework, what data is public, what is informational and where the source is.

## 1. Executive homepage redesign

### Problem
The homepage contains many strong elements, but too many modules compete for attention.

### Proposed solution
Create a cleaner executive dashboard:

1. Hero section with clear identity.
2. Three primary actions:
   - Financial profile
   - GNK ASG Insights
   - Intelligence Desk
3. Live status strip:
   - latest news status
   - market data status
   - latest insight
   - document availability
4. Compact cards for finance, group, technology, markets and publications.
5. Strong call-to-action to the Intelligence Desk.

### Benefit
The page becomes more understandable in the first 10 seconds and works better for journalists, partners, search visitors and mobile users.

## 2. Mobile-first navigation

### Problem
Mobile navigation must become simpler and more predictable.

### Proposed solution
Create a bottom mobile action bar:

- Home
- Insights
- Desk
- Markets
- Contact

The full menu remains available through a clean menu button.

### Benefit
The portal becomes easier to use on a phone, especially when a visitor comes from a social network or Google search.

## 3. One navigation system

### Problem
Multiple scripts and static menus can produce different routes.

### Proposed solution
Create one source of truth for navigation:

- desktop menu
- mobile menu
- footer links
- language switch
- share destinations

### Benefit
No more conflicting routes or confusing buttons.

## 4. Better language switching

### Problem
A visitor should not lose context when switching language.

### Proposed solution
Map each Croatian route to the matching English route and vice versa.

Examples:

- `/financije/` -> `/en/finance/`
- `/trzista/` -> `/en/markets/`
- `/tehnologija/` -> `/en/technology/`
- `/nermin-sefic/` -> `/en/nermin-sefic/`
- `/en/insights/` -> matching Croatian archive later if needed

### Benefit
Better international user experience and stronger search structure.

## 5. GNK ASG Insights archive

### Proposed solution
Create a polished English publication hub:

- daily insights
- AI and technology
- governance and transparency
- markets
- official public announcements
- author profile for Nermin Sefic
- weekly video brief archive

### Benefit
The portal becomes a content platform, not only a presentation website.

## 6. Nermin Sefic profile enhancement

### Proposed solution
Improve the author/profile layer:

- clear professional profile page
- structured data for person and organization context
- links to relevant GNK ASG Insights
- image cards with Nermin Sefic name and business topics
- internal links to GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd.

### Benefit
Search visibility improves through useful, structured and repeated high-quality context, not keyword stuffing.

## 7. Intelligence Desk 2.0

### Proposed solution
Unify all assistant layers into one consistent GNK ASG Intelligence Desk.

Capabilities:

- answer from portal data
- show source links
- find documents
- explain market panels
- open related publications
- explain the public content framework
- route user to the right page
- show whether information is public, informational or source-based

### Benefit
Visitors understand the portal faster, and the AI element becomes a real guide rather than a decorative chat.

## 8. Floating assistant cleanup

### Proposed solution
Make the floating button simple:

- Ask ASG Desk
- Latest Insights
- Market Status
- Share this page
- Contact

Remove artificial or unclear visitor counters unless real analytics is connected.

### Benefit
The floating layer becomes useful and trustworthy.

## 9. Contact and mail integration

### Proposed solution
Display `info@gnk-asg.hr` as the main public contact.

After setup:

- assistant mailbox sends routine replies
- agent clearly identifies itself
- private calendar used only for availability
- meeting proposals generated safely
- sensitive messages held for review

### Benefit
The portal becomes operational, not just informational.

## 10. Document center

### Proposed solution
Create a stronger document center:

- financial reports
- public registry links
- downloadable PDFs
- short plain-language explanation
- ask Desk about this document
- source verification buttons

### Benefit
Third-party users can verify public data without confusion.

## 11. Media and official announcement structure

### Proposed solution
Separate content types clearly:

- external news
- GNK ASG Insights
- official public announcements
- weekly video briefs
- document notices

### Benefit
Readers understand whether content is external, editorial, official or informational.

## 12. Market and reference panel clarity

### Proposed solution
Every market card should show:

- latest automated check
- source status
- delay note
- information-only note
- source link

### Benefit
Market data is transparent and less likely to be misunderstood.

## 13. Visual system for social and search

### Proposed solution
Generate or prepare consistent images:

- 1200 x 630 for portal/social previews
- 1280 x 720 for weekly video thumbnail
- 1080 x 1080 for square posts
- 1080 x 1920 for vertical formats

Themes:

- Nermin Sefic and corporate transparency
- GNK ASG Intelligence Desk
- GNK DINAMO Ltd. framework
- AI and business clarity
- official public information

### Benefit
More controlled visual identity across Google Images and networks.

## 14. Speed and mobile performance

### Proposed solution
Optimize:

- defer non-critical scripts
- compress large images
- lazy-load heavy modules
- reduce duplicate JS logic
- cache stable assets correctly
- separate critical CSS from secondary modules

### Benefit
Faster mobile load and better user retention.

## 15. Progressive Web App improvement

### Proposed solution
Improve install experience:

- show install button only when available
- show installed status when already installed
- provide offline fallback with last known data
- make start screen useful

### Benefit
The portal behaves more like a professional application.

## 16. Dashboard for internal control

### Proposed solution
Create an internal publishing/control dashboard showing:

- current activation status
- last article draft
- latest image package
- weekly video draft
- mail agent status
- network setup status
- failed checks
- next required human action

### Benefit
The user can see what is ready without reading repository files.

## 17. Activation switch

### Proposed solution
Keep everything behind a single public activation switch until the full package passes validation.

Activation states:

- locked_preparation
- draft_ready
- review_ready
- public_ready
- active

### Benefit
No half-finished functionality becomes visible.

## 18. Quality gate before going live

### Proposed solution
Before any public activation:

- no dead links
- no empty pages
- no incomplete buttons
- no broken share URLs
- no sensitive automatic content
- no unfinished network status
- no fake public counters
- no missing images
- no missing metadata

### Benefit
The portal goes live with a polished and coherent experience.

## Recommended implementation order after preparation

1. Stabilize navigation and mobile action model.
2. Add internal dashboard.
3. Build Insights as hidden-ready route.
4. Build visual templates.
5. Build daily publication generator.
6. Connect Desk to publications.
7. Prepare weekly video draft workflow.
8. Connect mail and calendar in draft-only mode.
9. Connect YouTube, then Facebook, then LinkedIn.
10. Activate public modules only after final review.

## Definition of 10x better

The portal is 10x better when:

- a new visitor understands the portal in 10 seconds;
- a mobile visitor can reach the main function in one tap;
- every important claim has a route or source;
- every article has a visual, metadata and canonical URL;
- the AI Desk explains the portal instead of acting like a generic chatbot;
- the contact system can handle routine messages;
- the private calendar supports availability without exposing privacy;
- networks distribute content from the portal rather than replacing it;
- nothing unfinished appears in public.
